name: sha1_attr_digest
title: Hash an object after attaching the sha1 attribute

origin.description: Attach the digest::sha1 attribute, then hash the object. Used for classes that can hold attributes.

arguments.name: digits
arguments.text: Recorded in the sha1 attribute. The default is 14.

arguments.name: zapsmall
arguments.text: Recorded in the sha1 attribute. The default is 7.

arguments.name: algo
arguments.text: The digest algorithm. Included in the attribute when it is not sha1.
